purpose: Emphasize that a particular reason makes an action possible or meaningful.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express feelings speak politely show respect
I entrusted it to you precisely because I trust you.
I warn you firmly precisely because I care.
Success feels wonderful precisely because of the struggle.
restrictions: Often gives a positive motivation for an apparently harsh action.
mistake: Keep the conditional form: 思えばこそ, not 思うばこそ.
